summary: Completed comprehensive testing of YABBAI Hub SSO (Zero-credential spoke) implementation. All backend and frontend SSO requirements validated successfully. The import order fix (load_dotenv before hub_sso import) is working correctly, and all Director-only routes are properly protected.

Backend: HUB_AUTH_URL correctly set to https://yabbai.network in .env

Backend: DELETE /api/token-mint requires Director authentication (401 without auth)
